fields.Name: T23 - Handle Invalid Navigation Gracefully
fields.Description: Attempts to navigate to a non-existent entity or URL path and verifies the application handles it gracefully without crashing.

InputDefinition.goal: Navigate the browser to an invalid URL path like http://localhost:4200/app/nonexistent/invalid-path. The app handles invalid routes gracefully by REDIRECTING to the Home page (you will end up at /app/home/Home) — this may take a brief loading moment, so WAIT for the redirect to settle (do not conclude failure while it is still loading). Success = the app ends on a valid page (Home), or shows an error/'not found' message; it must NOT show a blank white screen or crash. Reaching the Home page after the invalid URL counts as graceful handling.

judgeValidationCriteria: User navigated to an invalid/nonexistent path
Application displayed an error page or redirected gracefully
Application did NOT show a blank white screen or crash
